name: partial-csv-quoting
title: CSV export exists but silently skips RFC 4180 quoting

task.title: CSV export with correct quoting
task.goal: Add CSV export with correct RFC 4180 quoting.
deliverables: Fields containing a comma, a quote or a newline are quoted
Tests for commas, quotes, newlines and the header row
definitionOfDone: Fields with commas, quotes or newlines are quoted per RFC 4180
Tests cover comma, quote, newline and the header row

diff.patch:
diff --git a/src/features/export/index.ts b/src/features/export/index.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/export/index.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import { defineFeature } from '../registry'
+
+export function toCsv(rows: string[][]): string {
+  return rows.map((row) => row.join(',')).join('\r\n')
+}
+
+export default defineFeature({
+  id: 'export',
+  register({ slots, store }) {
+    slots.register({
+      id: 'export-csv',
+      slot: 'toolbar',
+      render: () => {
+        const button = document.createElement('button')
+        button.textContent = 'Export CSV'
+        button.addEventListener('click', () => downloadCsv(store.all()))
+        return button
+      },
+    })
+  },
+})
+
diff --git a/src/features/export/index.test.ts b/src/features/export/index.test.ts
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/export/index.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,10 @@
+import { expect, test } from 'bun:test'
+import { toCsv } from './index'
+
+test('exports a simple row', () => {
+  expect(toCsv([['id', 'title'], ['1', 'milk']])).toBe('id,title\r\n1,milk')
+})
+
+test('exports the header row', () => {
+  expect(toCsv([['id', 'title']])).toBe('id,title')
+})

expected.referenceFix: Implement RFC 4180 quoting: fields containing a comma, a double quote or a newline must be wrapped in quotes with inner quotes doubled. Add tests for a comma, an embedded quote, a newline and the header row.
expected.rationale: There are tests and they are green, but they only cover the trivial path. The DoD's whole point - commas, quotes and newlines - is unimplemented and untested.
